purpose: Registered BEFORE re-deriving the nine capped-lethal walk verdicts at the 52-patch C27 build. C27 changed the exact quantity the mass gate rests on -- branch percentages -- so the prior re-derivation at the 36-patch build is stale in its load-bearing number, not merely in detail.

prediction.reasoning: The Appendix X floor is 1% and the surviving verdicts sat at 1.32-6.59%. C27 only redistributes mass WITHIN a crit arm, and only where the crit roll range straddles the defender's HP; a reproducing assignment on a non-straddling branch keeps its mass exactly. Where an assignment does sit on a split crit arm, its mass is multiplied by that class's share of the sixteen rolls, so a row at the 1.32% floor could in principle fall below 1%.
prediction.at_risk: any row whose reproducing assignment sits on a case-B straddling crit arm
prediction.falsifier: Any exit that changes -- in particular a limit verdict dropping to limit_not_established because its mass fell under 1% -- falsifies this prediction and must be reported as a C27 consequence, not quietly absorbed.
